nodes.name: options.ts

nodes.name: deno.json
nodes.summary: Deno package manifest for the dev tooling package, declaring its name, version, exports, and import map.

nodes.name: deno.ts
nodes.summary: Dependency resolution utility that recursively walks TypeScript source via SWC AST visiting and an import map resolver to collect the full transitive import graph from entry points.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses SWC program visiting to extract import/export specifiers and resolves them through a Deno import map.

nodes.name: visit
nodes.summary: Recursively traverses an SWC AST program, invoking a visitor callback per node type.

nodes.name: importsFrom
nodes.summary: Parses a source file and collects all import/export specifier strings referenced within it.

nodes.name: skipPath
nodes.summary: Determines whether a given path should be skipped during dependency resolution based on extension and path heuristics.

nodes.name: resolveRecursively
nodes.summary: Recursively resolves a module path and all its transitive imports through the import map resolver, caching visited entries.

nodes.name: readImportMap
nodes.summary: Reads and parses the project's import_map.json or deno.json to obtain the import map.

nodes.name: resolveDeps
nodes.summary: Entry point that builds the import map, initializes the loader, and resolves the transitive dependency set for the given entries.

nodes.name: tailwind.ts
nodes.summary: Tailwind CSS build pipeline for Deco that loads the Tailwind config, computes content roots via dependency resolution, and bundles/minifies CSS through PostCSS.
nodes.languageNotes: Runs PostCSS with tailwindcss, autoprefixer, and cssnano; derives content roots dynamically using resolveDeps.

nodes.name: loadTailwindConfig
nodes.summary: Dynamically imports the project's tailwind.config.ts, falling back gracefully with a warning when absent.

nodes.name: bundle
nodes.summary: Runs the PostCSS processor (import, tailwind, autoprefixer, optional cssnano) over the source CSS and returns the bundled output.

nodes.name: withReleaseContent
nodes.summary: Augments the Tailwind config content array by walking the project for .tsx files, applying exclusion rules, and resolving their dependency graph.

nodes.name: getCSS
nodes.summary: Produces the final CSS by bundling with the release-augmented Tailwind content config.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Loads config and options as needed, generates the CSS, and writes the result to disk.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documentation for the Deco runtime config resolver engine, covering resolvers, resolvables, the resolution algorithm, parallelism, and dangling reference handling.

nodes.name: mod.ts
nodes.summary: Public entry point for the engine package, re-exporting ImportMapBuilder, ImportMapResolver, loader, and parsing utilities.

nodes.name: mod.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting Preact hooks for Deco such as useDevice, useSection, usePartialSection, useScript, and early hints helpers.

nodes.name: live.gen.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated manifest file re-exporting the project Manifest type.

nodes.name: live.ts
nodes.summary: Top-level live entry module for the Deco runtime.

nodes.name: mod.web.ts
nodes.summary: Browser-only public entry point re-exporting invocation utilities, proxy/stream helpers, and manifest-derived invoke types.

nodes.name: styles.ts
nodes.summary: Fresh plugin that injects a styles element into rendered pages via a render middleware.

nodes.name: stylesPlugin
nodes.summary: Factory creating a Fresh plugin that wraps rendering to inject a styles element with a fixed element id.

nodes.name: FreshHeadCompat.ts
nodes.summary: Compatibility shim re-exporting Fresh Head-related symbols for the HTMX runtime.

nodes.name: mod.ts
nodes.summary: Public entry point for the HTMX runtime, re-exporting the framework, bindings, Head, and asset helpers.

nodes.name: watcher.ts
nodes.summary: Development watcher script that spawns a Deno subprocess to run a module and streams its merged stdout/stderr output.

nodes.name: runModule
nodes.summary: Spawns a Deno subprocess to execute the resolved target module with the provided arguments.

nodes.name: printStdout
nodes.summary: Merges a process's stdout and stderr readable streams and pipes them to the console output.

nodes.name: changelog.ts
nodes.summary: Script that fetches GitHub release tags and prints the changelog diff between semantic versions.

nodes.name: printDiff
nodes.summary: Requests release data from a GitHub repository and prints versions newer than the given semantic version.

nodes.name: codemod.ts
nodes.summary: Large codemod script that automates upgrading Deco sites: rewriting imports, updating deno.json, swapping the Tailwind plugin, and pinning/upgrading Deco versions.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of chained string replacements and JSR latest-version lookups to migrate project configuration.

nodes.name: runCodeMod
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the full Deco site migration: resolves latest JSR package versions, rewrites imports and config, swaps the Tailwind plugin, and applies version pinning/upgrade transforms.

nodes.name: deno.json
nodes.summary: Deno package manifest for the scripts package, declaring name, version, exports, publish settings, and import map.
